api_checks.description: GET /documents/queue → 401 — no Authorization header; no handler body executes
GET /documents/queue → 403 — with a CUSTOMER token, while GET /products with that same token is 200
GET /openapi.json → 200 — enumerate every UNDERWRITER/ADMIN route; the generated suite reports 100% covered by both a no-session and a wrong-role case
GET /audit-entries → 200 — as ADMIN after an UNDERWRITER decision; an entry carries the acting user id and a timestamp
